title: Malacañang dismisses Sara Duterte’s criticism on school shootings

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday said it cannot force anyone to understand the country’s situation regarding a series of school shooting incidents if that person is “unwilling” or simply unable to do so. The remark was in response to Vice President Sara Duterte’s criticism of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s administration over the recent school shootings, the latest of which occurred in South Cotabato and left three students dead.
